my_resume.summary: Program Management professional with 5+ years of experience turning business requirements into executable plans and driving cross-functional teams through delivery, with a Master's in Engineering Management specializing in Project Management.

work_experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Led a team of 20, allocating workload, managing backlogs, and tracking task and sprint status to improve resource utilization and support timely delivery of sprint commitments.

Built and executed Plans of Record across concurrent programs, managing scope, schedules, stakeholder communication, infrastructure setup, test plan coordination, and prioritization to drive on-time, on-budget, and in-scope delivery.
Tracked key program metrics and deviations from the Plan of Record, proactively escalating risks and issues and driving corrective actions to prevent schedule and delivery impacts.
Led sprint planning and Scrum calls, establishing task assignments, tracking milestones, and coordinating dependencies to maintain execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Collaborated with stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into structured tasks, stories, and features, improving requirement clarity and reducing rework and downstream defects.

Delivered weekly program reviews and status reports to Director-level leadership, consolidating program health, metrics, risks, issues, and progress to drive cross-functional alignment and timely decision-making.

work_experience.title: Sales Planning Executive
bullets: Coordinated 5+ product launches and cross-functional initiatives, managing schedules, requirements, vendors, and deliverables from planning through execution to ensure on-time delivery.
Analyzed 100K+ sales, customer, inventory, and production data points across 20+ dealerships, providing product performance and demand insights to support planning and operational decisions.
Built Tableau dashboards and daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports across motorcycle models, providing Sales and management with visibility into key metrics.

Coordinated with Sales, Service, Production, Logistics, and Operations to communicate customer requirements, resolve issues, manage dependencies, and maintain cross-functional alignment and execution.

education.degree: Master of Science, Engineering and Technology Management

skills.stakeholder_management: Requirements Gathering, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Executive Communication, Issue Resolution, Prioritization
skills.tools: Jira, Excel, Tableau, ERP, CRM, Canva, Azure, Figma, Confluence

job_posting.title: Technical Customer Role (AI company)
responsibilities: Own technical customer inquiries and escalations from initial request through resolution.
Become deeply knowledgeable about the company's products, models, APIs, capabilities, and technical workflows.
Investigate and troubleshoot customer issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with Engineering and Product to drive resolution.
Translate customer questions and business requirements into clear technical problems and actionable next steps.
Communicate technical concepts, limitations, workarounds, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Partner closely with Engineering and Product to prioritize high-impact customer issues and ensure timely follow-through.
Identify patterns across customer inquiries and surface recurring product gaps, bugs, feature requests, and opportunities.
Build processes, documentation, and tooling that improve how we manage and resolve technical customer requests as we scale.
Help customers navigate complex use cases and get the most out of the company's technology.
requirements: Strong technical fluency and ability to quickly understand complex products, APIs, systems, and workflows.
Experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Technical Program Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, Developer Support, or a similar function.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, particularly when working through ambiguous or complex technical issues.
Ability to communicate effectively with both engineers and customers and translate between technical and business contexts.
Exceptional ownership and follow-through, with the ability to drive multiple requests and workstreams to resolution.
Strong prioritization skills and comfort operating in a high-volume, fast-moving environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
nice_to_have: Experience with AI/ML, generative AI, video, or creative technology products.
Experience supporting APIs, developer products, or technically sophisticated enterprise customers.
Familiarity with debugging API requests, integrations, logs, and production issues.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to turn customer feedback into product improvements.
Experience operating in a rapidly scaling technology company.
